name: XLA_ACCOUNTING_ERRORS
description: This table contains the errors encountered during execution of the Accounting Program.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the categorization of accounting events that is unique within an application and event class.

columns.name: OAR_ID
columns.description: Online accounting request idenfier.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_ERROR_ID
columns.description: Identifier that is associated to an error resulted from accounting processing.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Identifies subledger transactions associated with the accounting events.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a self-contained accounting information set for single or multiple legal or management entities.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Identifier for a accounting batch.

columns.name: ENCODED_MSG
columns.description: Error message as provided by the  Oracle Middleware Extensions for Applications API.

columns.name: AE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Subledger journal entry header identifier.

columns.name: AE_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Subledger journal entry line identifier.

columns.name: MESSAGE_NUMBER
columns.description: Message number that is associated with each error when processing events for accounting.

columns.name: ERROR_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Code for the sub-routine  that generated the error  message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the message which was used to generate the message text in the ENCODED_MSG column.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
